title: Polar Coordinates
description: Polar Coordinates — remaps the image between rectangular and polar space: wrap it into a circle, unwrap a circle into a strip, fly down an infinite tunnel, or fold a panorama into a "little planet". Adjustable centre, zoom, rotation, spin, angular repeats and a seamless mirror option. Works on the camera, a dropped clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
